purpose: Supplement saved occurrence classification with physical-rain point-estimate contingency and error scores for CONTROL_E0 and CANDIDATE_COSINE9

data.scope_check: 2024 Development weather and reference only, plus the inherited 2023-derived fixed mask and frozen normalization metadata

point_methods.B: Inherited mixture-median proxy: p_occ < 0.5 gives zero, otherwise u=(p_occ-0.5)/p_occ and inherited piecewise-linear interpolation in log1p space with support-edge handling below tau_1
point_methods.interpretation: Finite-node point proxies with physical units mm/h
point_methods.reporting_policy: Report A, B and C together without selecting a winner from Development scores

proposed_outputs.boundary_counts: Count equality to each FP32 threshold for reference and each A/B/C proxy
proposed_outputs.denominator_policy: Undefined ratios are null, with their zero denominator recorded
proposed_outputs.aggregation: Full fixed valid population, paired candidate-minus-control summaries

usable_components: Historical frozen provider B78Adapter and its original B7 forward graph
required_new_wiring: A two-arm registry binding the exact new E0 and COSINE9 checkpoints and their saved E9 reports
A new two-task approval validator and once-only controller scope
An ABC-only accumulator using the declared FP32 boundary convention and recording boundary-equality counts
A complete bounded metadata reservation mechanism covering validation and worker setup before their source reads
A new runtime binding that matches the COSINE9 training environment
Explicit new output namespace and paired result receipts
reuse_design.excluded_legacy_path: The historical default PointAccumulator also computes candidate_D via conditional-CDF interpolation on a supported subset. It must be replaced before execution to keep this package restricted to A/B/C point scores.
reuse_design.boundary_compatibility: The old default PointAccumulator compares FP64 point proxies directly. The later V3 JointCollector uses FP32 predictions and FP32 thresholds. This proposed package inherits the later V3 convention explicitly.

original_metric_gate.on_failure: Stop, preserve partial receipts, and require a separate decision before further execution

runtime_reference.forward_precision: Inherited BF16 autocast and FP64 evaluation accumulation
runtime_reference.legacy_runtime_issue: The old nine-model diagnostic proposal bound Python 3.12.14. Its runtime grant cannot be inherited for this new package.
runtime_reference.historical_driver_cudnn_limitation: Complete old control driver and cuDNN fingerprints remain unavailable

known_source_reference_lower_bound.byte_semantics: Full delivered weather/static payload lengths plus archive-length reservations for separate checkpoint SHA256 and deserialization opens. This is not a disk-sector measurement.

metadata_examples_stat_only.reservation_note: PopulationPlan separately hashes and opens statistics.sqlite, reserving its full archive length for each access. Metadata files can also be hashed and parsed more than once. Unique sizes do not establish a complete read budget.

unresolved_before_execution: Implement and inspect the exact two-arm runner and its complete transitive source bindings

Freeze all metadata paths, archive reservation caps and open caps for controller and each worker, including validation reads
Freeze total source reservation upper limit including metadata, checkpoint hashing and loads
Freeze per-arm and package time limits, output storage cap, initial and per-arm free-space requirements, RAM, commit and GPU admission
Freeze new private output root and sanitized public result location
Verify source-volume availability without opening scientific payloads
Run targeted CPU synthetic/mock checks for approval identity, once-only behavior, source limits, threshold boundaries, zero denominators and original-metric gate handling
Obtain the required review status and researcher's concrete approval for this exact inference/evaluation package
